idea-plugin.name: Lark Connector
idea-plugin.description:
Lark Connector connects your Lark Base or Feishu Bitable task boards directly inside Android Studio and IntelliJ IDEA with live REST API synchronization.

Key Features

  • Live Lark Bitable API Sync: Real-time dynamic fetch of tables, fields, and records directly from Lark Base Open APIs.
  • Dynamic Table Schema & Columns: Automatically renders all actual columns (e.g., OKRs, Task Leaders, Start/End Dates, Checkboxes) as separate headers.
  • Schema-Aware Add Record Dialog: Create live records on Lark Base with option dropdowns, person selectors, date parsing, and numeric validation.
  • Auto-Refresh Timer: Configurable automatic background refresh interval (Off, 1 Min, 5 Min, 10 Min).
  • Multi-Base Support: Connect and manage multiple Lark Base sheets seamlessly from a single unified dropdown.
  • Diagnostics & Error Logging: Detailed log inspector and one-click copy tool for API troubleshooting.

Setup & Usage Guide

  1. Create an internal App in Lark Developer Console (open.larksuite.com/app).
  2. In Permissions & Scopes, grant the bitable:app permission.
  3. Important: Click Create Version and publish your app so permission scopes take effect!
  4. Copy your Tenant Access Token (t-...) from Credentials & Test Notes or API Explorer.
  5. Open Android Studio, launch Lark Connector tool window, paste your Lark Base URL and Tenant Access Token.
